greeting.text: Oh, 302! Perfect timing. I made some braised beef, take some~

lines.text: Cooking side dishes alone is such a hassle, right?
My kids don't even eat braised beef anymore. Hurts my feelings.
Bring the container back whenever. No rush.
It might be a bit salty. Have it with rice.
You've looked a little tired lately. Are you eating properly?

flushRemark.text: Oh, you're blushing. Don't feel pressured~

closers.parried: Oh, you're busy, go on! Take the food though!
closers.endured: Oh, I kept you. Don't forget the food~
closers.sos: Take your call, go! Here's the food.
